name: sergio-web-gallery-reference-sources
purpose: Deep gallery scraping for Web Factory design intelligence. Screenshots and structure are reference-only unless a source or linked repo has a compatible license.

sources.name: 21st.dev Community Components
sources.usage: Component discovery and UI pattern extraction. Verify each community component before copying code.

sources.name: 21st.dev Landing Page Components
sources.usage: High-density landing-page component discovery: heroes, features, CTAs, pricing, testimonials and animated sections. Verify each component license before code reuse.

sources.name: Registry Directory
sources.usage: Find current shadcn-compatible registries, install commands, authors, freshness and component counts. Use as discovery; verify registry license before code reuse.

sources.name: Magic UI
sources.usage: Animated marketing components, effects and motion patterns for landing pages. Prefer local MIT repo or registry install commands for implementation.

sources.name: Aceternity UI
sources.usage: Motion-rich hero, bento, parallax, canvas and premium landing patterns. Use for art direction and motion taxonomy; verify free/premium license before code reuse.

sources.name: Aceternity shadcn Blocks
sources.usage: Landing page blocks and motion ideas. Capture screenshots, code links and animation signals; do not copy premium code without license.

sources.name: Shadcnblocks
sources.usage: shadcn-native block taxonomy, layout variants and section recipes. Use screenshots/structure by default; copy code only from free blocks after license review.

sources.name: Kibo UI
sources.usage: Accessible shadcn-compatible component ideas and registry signals. Verify repository/license before copying code.

sources.name: Lapa Ninja
sources.usage: Landing-page structure, section ordering, visual hierarchy and copy patterns. Do not copy site code or proprietary assets.

sources.name: Componentry
sources.usage: Reusable component inspiration. Prefer the locally cached MIT repository for code.

sources.name: Motion Primitives
sources.usage: Motion patterns and interaction primitives. Prefer the locally cached MIT repository for code.

sources.name: Motion Examples
sources.usage: 450+ copy-paste animation snippets (React, JavaScript, Vue) on the Motion library we already ship by default. Mine microinteraction mechanics (springs, exit, timelines, scroll). Free examples are reusable after retokenizing; Motion+ examples are paid, do not copy.

sources.name: shadcn/ui
sources.usage: Base component architecture and accessible UI primitives. Prefer the locally cached MIT repository for code.

sources.name: Tremor
sources.usage: Dashboard and chart component taxonomy: KPI cards, area/bar/line charts, tables and filters. Apache-2.0, so code is reusable after review; prefer the local repo or npm install.

sources.name: Tabler
sources.usage: MIT admin dashboard UI kit: layouts, data tables, charts, forms and empty/loading states. Prefer the local MIT repo for code reuse.

sources.name: shadcn/ui Charts
sources.usage: MIT Recharts-based chart blocks (area, bar, line, pie, radar, radial) with tooltip variants. Prefer the local MIT repo or shadcn registry install.

sources.name: shadcn/ui Dashboard Example
sources.usage: Reference layout for an analytics dashboard: KPI row, chart grid and data table. Structure and spacing reference; code via MIT repo or `npx shadcn add dashboard-01`.

sources.name: Hugging Face Spaces
sources.usage: Community data-apps and dashboards (Gradio/Streamlit): data-viz layout, filters and real-time patterns. Study flow and structure only; license varies per Space, verify before reusing code or assets.

sources.name: Efferd Blocks
sources.usage: Block-level layout discovery. Verify each block license before reuse.

sources.name: Watermelon UI
sources.usage: Component taxonomy and interaction reference. Verify license before copying code.

sources.name: Fontpair
sources.usage: Font-pair inspiration and typographic mood extraction. Check font licenses before use.

sources.name: Dribbble Axion Shot
sources.usage: Mood reference only. Do not copy proprietary layout, assets or code.

sources.name: 10x App
sources.usage: Product and interaction study. The cached repo uses PolyForm Noncommercial, so do not use its code in client/commercial work.

sources.name: Landingfolio
sources.usage: Landing page examples, templates and component inspiration. Do not copy templates or proprietary assets.

sources.name: SaaSFrame Landing Pages
sources.usage: SaaS landing page hero, value proposition, social proof, pricing and mobile-first CRO patterns.

sources.name: SaaS Landing Page
sources.usage: SaaS page section taxonomy: landing, pricing, about, features, testimonials, FAQ and contact.

sources.name: Awwwards Winning Websites
sources.usage: Art direction, typography, motion and experimental interaction reference. Translate into one usable design move for ONIA client work.

sources.name: Deck.gallery
sources.usage: Curated presentation decks, slides and brand guidelines. Typography scale, hierarchy and storytelling reference for propuestas, OG images and slides; not a web-layout source. Do not copy decks or proprietary assets.

sources.name: Recent Design
sources.usage: Daily recent design references across websites, OG images, app screenshots and design skills.

sources.name: Mobbin Web
sources.usage: Real app/web UI flows, copywriting and interaction patterns. Use for UX flow study, not visual copying.
